title: What does a missing tail prove?
hook: An observation and its explanation are different things.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The picture shows a salamander with a missing tail; it does not show the event that caused the loss. Injury has multiple possible causes, so a predator explanation needs additional evidence.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: A salamander is seen without its tail. Does this observation alone establish a predator caused the loss?
